note: Triennial election of the Newry No. 1 (County Down) rural district councillors. A contest was expected in Clonallon, but Mr. Frederick James Clemo withdrew on 11 May 1927, and every member was returned unopposed, so there was no poll. Filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
